title: The bounded elementary substructure relation is transitive
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 701-702: the relation of bounded elementary substructure is transitive in the bound. The proof (source lines 703-705) is a short but genuinely structured argument: one takes a set of at most n elements outside A, writes it as the part lying in B together with the rest, obtains from the hypothesis on B and C that B is elementary in the enlarged B, splits the problem with the diamond condition, and then applies the hypothesis on A and B to the part lying in B. The statement records only the transitivity and neither the splitting of the added set nor the two applications of the boundedness hypothesis.
